children: Shaping the dental business since 15+ years
Over 12,000 dentists and orthodontists worldwide treat their patients with the Alignaa. System
Over 200,000 patients treated with our system since 2013
WE EXCEL NOT ONLY IN QUALITY
At Alignaa. we deeply believe that a medical treatment should only be done by those who can provide excellent quality.
Only qualified dentists or dental technicians with a degree are involved in the Alignaa. planning and manufacturing process
We provide additional aligners for fine-tuning until the predicted result is achieved – without charge
are treated with our technology from Germany since 2013
We produce all our aligners exclusively from the material “DURAN+”.
This material is provided by the German manufacturer SCHEU DENTAL based in Iserlohn, Germany

The treatment price is based solely on whether it’s for one or two arches. The number of aligners required doesn’t affect the cost. This means you can provide your patients with an immediate, fixed price.
Advanced 3D simulation tailored to each treatment
You can present your patient with a 3D simulation of the final result. Simply share the provided file to easily showcase the simulation.
No hidden cancellation fees—no obligations. The 3D simulation is completely free. This means you can proactively approach all your patients and offer them a 3D simulation.
Every plan created by qualified experts
Unlike many providers, we work exclusively with qualified dental technicians and dentists to create every treatment plan.
With our system we can cover more indications than many other systems. We correct from 3 to 3, 5 to 5 or even 7 to 7.
We offer free, regular certification courses for Alignaa. users. These online trainings are led by our experienced orthodontic consultants.
All patient data is protected under GDPR. Data processing agreements are available when needed.
IPR and attachment placement can be performed easily, following our clear instructions.
All aligners needed for the fine-tuning phase are included free of charge until the planned 3D simulation results are achieved.
Fast processing: treatment planning in 5 working days, production in just 10 days after plan approval.
With our optimised system, in total you need just 1 hour 20 minutes per patient for the entire treatment, without compromising quality.
Free Aligners in case of loss
The fixed price does not only include any necessary extra aligners and retention aligners but even replacement aligners in case of loss.

children: Yes! We accept intraoral-scans of any scanner that support stl. format or ply. format. You also have the option of providing us with your scans via an external scanning system (such as 3shape).
You don´t have a scanner yet? Just ask us about the option to buy one from us for great conditions.
Do you accept impressions or models?
No, but we accept intraoral-scans of any scanner that supports stl. format or ply. format. You also have the option of providing us with your scans via an external scanning system (such as 3shape).

We believe that precision is a must when providing medical treatments. This is best achieved through scans. You don´t have a scanner yet? Just ask us about the option to buy one from us for great conditions.
Do I have to pay for the 3D simulation?

No! The 3D simulation is always free of charge, regardless of whether the patient decides to undergo treatment with you or not. This allows you to make Alignaa. treatment appealing to all of your patients without any cost risk. It is even possible to request changes to each simulation. Every revision is also free of charge!
What is the cost for the retention aligner?

We at Alignaa. know how important it is for satisfied patients and your reputation, to make sure the new smiles last. With us, you get a retention aligner automatically and for FREE with every treatment order.

children: Seit über 15 Jahren prägen wir die Dentalbranche
Über 12.000 Zahnärzte und Kieferorthopäden weltweit behandeln ihre Patienten mit dem Alignaa. System
Seit 2013 wurden bereits über 200.000 Patienten mit unserem System behandelt
WIR ÜBERZEUGEN NICHT NUR DURCH QUALITÄT
Wir bei Alignaa sind der festen Überzeugung, dass medizinische Behandlungen nur von jenen durchgeführt werden sollten, die eine hervorragende Qualität bieten können.
Nur qualifizierte Zahnärzte oder Zahntechniker mit einem Abschluss sind am Planungs- und Herstellungsprozess von Alignaa beteiligt.
Wir stellen zusätzliche Aligner zum Finetuning zur Verfügung, bis das vorhergesagte Ergebnis erreicht ist – ohne Aufpreis.
Seit 2013 wurden mehr als 200.000 Patienten mit unserer Technologie aus Deutschland behandelt.
Alle unsere Aligner werden ausschließlich aus dem Material „DURAN+“ hergestellt. Dieses Material wird vom deutschen Hersteller SCHEU DENTAL mit Sitz in Iserlohn, Deutschland, geliefert.

props.className: wp-block-uagb-image aligncenter uagb-block-a1e5d07e wp-block-uagb-image--layout-default wp-block-uagb-image--effect-static wp-block-uagb-image--align-center

children: Der Behandlungspreis richtet sich ausschließlich danach, ob es sich um einen oder zwei Kiefer handelt. Die Anzahl der erforderlichen Aligner hat keinen Einfluss auf die Kosten. Das bedeutet, dass Sie Ihren Patienten sofort einen Festpreis nennen können.
Sie können Ihrem Patienten eine 3D-Simulation mit dem Endergebnis zeigen. Sie erhalten den Link für die Simulation und können ihn ganz einfach an Ihre Patienten weitergeben.

Keine versteckten Stornierungsgebühren – keine Verpflichtungen. Die 3D-Simulation ist völlig kostenlos. Das bedeutet, dass Sie proaktiv auf alle Ihre Patienten zugehen und ihnen eine 3D-Simulation anbieten können.
Jeder Plan wird von qualifizierten Experten erstellt:

Nur wenige Anbieter auf dem Markt arbeiten ausschließlich mit professionellen und qualifizierten Spezialisten zusammen. Unsere Behand-lungspläne werden ausschließlich von professionellen Zahntechnikern und Zahnärzten erstellt.
Mit unserem System können wir mehr Indikationen abdecken als viele andere Aligner Systeme. Wir korrigieren von 3 bis 3, 5 bis 5 oder sogar 7 bis 7.
Wir bieten kostenlose, regelmäßige Zertifizierungskurse für Alignaa.-Anwender an. Diese Online-Schulungen werden von unseren erfahrenen kieferorthopädischen Beratern geleitet.
Gemäß dem DSGVO-Standard sind alle Daten, die wir von Ihnen und Ihren Patienten erhalten, geschützt und sicher. Verträge für die weitere Datenverarbeitung sind verfügbar.
Sie erhalten klare und einfache Instruktionen:
Sie können die Instruktionen, die Sie von uns für ASR (Stripping) und Attachment-Platzierung erhalten, leicht befolgen.
Sie erhalten alle Aligner für die Finetuning Phase kostenlos, bis die geplanten Ergebnisse gemäß der 3D-Simulation erreicht sind.
Behandlungsplanung innerhalb von 5 Werktagen, Fertigung innerhalb von nur 10 Tagen nach Planfreigabe.
Mit unserem optimierten System benötigen Sie insgesamt nur 1 Stunde und 20 Minuten pro Patient für die gesamte Behandlung, ohne Kompromisse bei der Qualität einzugehen.
Der Festpreis umfasst nicht nur alle erforderlichen zusätzlichen Aligner und Retentionsaligner, sondern sogar Ersatzaligner für den Fall eines Verlusts.

children: Personal data refers to information that reveals or could reveal the user’s identity. We adhere to the principle of data minimization. We refrain from collecting personal data to the greatest extent possible.
Personal data is used exclusively for the establishment, content, performance, or fulfillment of the contractual relationship (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).

Furthermore, personal data is processed only to the extent that we have obtained your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR) or where the processing is necessary for our legitimate interests and provided that a balancing test shows that no overriding interests, fundamental rights, or freedoms on your part stand in the way (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
We may use processors to process your personal data, but we will generally not disclose personal data to third parties.

The data is only transferred to the shipping company responsible for delivery for the purpose of fulfilling the contract, to the extent necessary for the delivery of ordered goods. To process payments, the payment data required for this purpose is transferred to the bank responsible for the payment and, if applicable, to the commissioned and selected payment service provider.
Your personal data is processed exclusively within the EU, unless otherwise stated below.

We process personal data in accordance with the provisions of the European General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the German Federal Data Protection Act (BDSG). Since the data we process includes health-related data about you, a specific legal basis is required for this pursuant to Art. 9 GDPR. This basis is provided by Art. 9(2)(h) GDPR. Additionally, you may revoke your consent at any time with future effect.

When you visit the website, general technical information is collected. This includes the IP address used, the time of the visit, the duration of the visit, the browser type, and, if applicable, the referring page. For technical reasons, this usage data is recorded in a log file and may be used and stored for the purpose of statistical analysis of this website. This usage data is not linked to your other personal data.

Registration is required for full use of the functions of our website. Registration data is collected through your corresponding entries and used for the specifically stated purpose in accordance with your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).
After the purpose for which the data was collected has been fulfilled, we will store your personal data only for as long as required by law (in particular tax laws).

You may request information from us regarding whether we process your personal data, and if so, you have the right to access this personal data and to receive the additional information specified in Article 15 of the GDPR.
You have the right to have inaccurate personal data concerning you rectified and, pursuant to Article 16 of the GDPR, may request the completion of incomplete personal data.
You have the right to request that we erase your personal data without undue delay. We are obligated to erase it without undue delay, particularly if any of the following grounds apply:
Your personal data is no longer necessary for the purposes for which it was collected or otherwise processed.
You withdraw your consent on which the processing of your data was based, and there is no other legal basis for the processing.
Your data has been processed unlawfully.
The right to erasure does not apply if your personal data is necessary for the establishment, exercise, or defense of our legal claims.
Sie haben das Recht von uns die Einschränkung der Verarbeitung Ihrer personenbezogenen Daten zu verlangen, wenn

You have the right to request that we restrict the processing of your personal data if you contest the accuracy of the data and we are therefore verifying its accuracy, the processing is unlawful and you oppose erasure and instead request restriction of use, we no longer need the data, but you require it to assert, exercise, or defend legal claims, you have objected to the processing of your data, and it has not yet been determined whether our legitimate grounds override your grounds.

You have the right to receive the personal data concerning you that you have provided to us in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format, and you have the right to transmit this data to another controller without hindrance from us, provided that the processing is based on consent or a contract and is carried out by us using automated means.
To the extent that the processing of your personal data is based on consent, you have the right to withdraw this consent at any time.
2.7 General Provisions and Right to File a Complaint

The exercise of your rights as described above is generally free of charge for you. You have the right to file a complaint directly with the supervisory authority responsible for us, the State Data Protection Commissioner.
All data on our website is protected against loss, destruction, unauthorized access, alteration, and disclosure through technical and organizational measures.

To operate this website, we use cookies and server-side sessions in which data may be stored. We use only cookies or server-side sessions that are technically necessary for the operation of this website (e.g., spam protection for contact forms, shopping cart functionality) and where a balancing of interests shows that there are no overriding interests on your part that would preclude their use (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

We use so-called web fonts from Google Ireland Limited, Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland (“Google”) to display a consistent font on our website. These are automatically stored in your browser cache when you visit one of our pages to enable the desired display. If your browser does not support the web fonts used, a standard font from your computer may be used instead. No user interests are affected here that would outweigh this technical necessity (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). You can view Google’s privacy policy here: https://www.google.com/policies/privacy/ Further information on Google Web Fonts can be found at https://developers.google.com/fonts/faq

On our websites, we use ajax.googleapis.com/jQuery, operated by Google Ireland Limited, Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland (“Google”). This service primarily enables a modern design for our websites. To increase the loading speed of our websites, we use Google’s CDN (Content Delivery Network) to load this library. In addition, Google may send further cookies to your browser. We have no influence over this process and do not receive any information from Google regarding the transmitted content. The legal basis for the use of ajax and the transmission of your data to it is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (Legitimate Interest in Data Processing). You can view Google’s privacy policy here: https://www.google.com/policies/privacy/
